The following events took place in '''470 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*In a short-lived [[Corellian independence movement|effort]] to achieve independence, the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] invokes the ancient [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|constitutional]] clause of ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', which allowed them to temporarily withdraw from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
